# From chaos to a hello, drawn with particles

A Fable 5.2 video by [@ici_dab](https://x.com/ici_dab).

[![From chaos to a hello, drawn with particles](https://media.skillry.dev/fable-5-2/ici-dab-098351/preview.1a39738553.webp)](https://media.skillry.dev/fable-5-2/ici-dab-098351/video.9241ab6b10.mp4)

[▶ Watch the video](https://media.skillry.dev/fable-5-2/ici-dab-098351/video.9241ab6b10.mp4) · [Original post](https://x.com/ici_dab/status/2119901910237098351) · [On Skillry](https://skillry.dev/ai-videos/fable5-2/ici-dab-098351?utm_source=github&utm_medium=readme&utm_campaign=awesome-fable5-2-videos)

- **Category:** Motion graphics
- **Length:** 1:08 (1080×1080)
- **Posted:** 2026-11-09

## Prompt

```text
the prompt: "I need you to create the most impressive thing I can share with people when you launch. It needs to be embeddable in a post and i can preface it however you like. it needs to have a visceral impact on people to show what you can do and the range of capabilities. It should grab them quickly. Be amazingly clever about this."
```

Shared in a [separate post](https://x.com/ici_dab/status/2119902189271605579).

## From the post

> i gave Fable 5.2 the prompt from this interesting article by @emollick  with a minor adjustment.
>
> thats what i got.
> the music is hypnotising.
> amazing.

name: Submit a Fable 5.2 video
description: Suggest a video for the list
title: "Add: "
labels: ["new video"]
body:
  - type: input
    id: post
    attributes:
      label: Link to the post
      description: The post where the author shares the video and says Fable 5.2 made it.
      placeholder: https://x.com/...
    validations:
      required: true
  - type: textarea
    id: prompt
    attributes:
      label: Prompt (optional)
      description: The exact prompt, if the author published it, with a link to where.
  - type: checkboxes
    id: checks
    attributes:
      label: Checks
      options:
        - label: The author says in their own post that Fable 5.2 made this video.
          required: true
        - label: It is not a side-by-side comparison of several models.
          required: true
